'''''Kesh''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] that arrived in the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]], dropped off the [[Class-A cargo container|Container]] ''[[Wathis]]'', and then fled the area.
